rule: This map classifies current semantics without moving, renaming or deleting columns.

groups.note: Current runtime identity. Do not create a replacement master.
Several fields can be share-class specific in fund data models, but current AfricaFunds grain is not certified as Fund vs ShareClass. Do not move or split by assumption.
societe_id is the preferred relational direction, but 71 live funds lack it and name-based consumers remain.
pays is heavily consumed; pays_one requires consumer/source audit before any deprecation.
Candidate core legal-vehicle attributes for Institutional/DDQ.
Need source/provenance and controlled vocabularies before hard institutional gates.
String categories and FundAfrica mapped categories coexist. Reference tables exist live; migration must be adapter-first.
Must distinguish declared benchmark, legacy index label and FundAfrica analytical mapping. Do not collapse them without evidence.
Reusable by fund pages, SEO text, Due Diligence and Institutional workflows; source/version lineage should be added rather than copied.
Currently strings. Do not normalize into organization entities until identity/source coverage is audited.
Some fields are caches/snapshots while detailed time-series values live in valorisations. Never treat cache freshness as source data without reconciliation.
Do not surface through new public/institutional view models by default; audit purpose, permissions and consumers first.

organization_master.caveat: Manager aliases/history and hard FK coverage are not yet canonical.

target_conceptual_entities_not_yet_schem.warning: Do not infer rows/classes solely from ISIN, currency or name.
Only create if source evidence and real umbrella structures require it.

institutional_reuse: Mandates/Eligibility must query this canonical authority through versioned view models.
DDQ should reference fund/manager IDs and canonical documents, not copy master data.
RFP responses may add mandate-specific answers but must not redefine fund identity.
Investment Committee snapshots must retain exact fund/master version or data cutoff used.
frontend_reuse: FundIdentityViewModel should hide storage redundancy while preserving route compatibility.
SEO/Schema.org should consume stable entity semantics, not raw legacy field names.
Atomic organisms should receive normalized business concepts while legacy routes are migrated incrementally.
next_action: Use live identity-gap diagnostic to decide whether societe_id normalization and explicit ShareClass/SubFund entities are warranted; no schema split before that evidence.
